        self.next = None

        self.data = data
        self.left = None
        self.right = None

def convert(head, root):
    if not head:
        return None
    
    # Create the root node
    root = TreeNode(head.data)
    head = head.next
    
    # Create a queue for level order traversal
    queue = [root]
    
    # Process nodes in the queue

        current = queue.pop(0)
        
        # Create left child if exists
        if head:
            current.left = TreeNode(head.data)
            queue.append(current.left)
            head = head.next
        
        # Create right child if exists
        if head:
            current.right = TreeNode(head.data)
            queue.append(current.right)
            head = head.next
